projectors.candidateCheck: Previously discussed candidate, retained for testing: enlarging the full portrait raster from 20 ft to 26 ft at a fixed center adds 3 ft at the top. At a 38–39 ft throw this needs approximately 1.46–1.50:1, within the ET-DLE150 range. A 20 ft mapped picture would use approximately 985 of 1280 portrait pixels. Wider black raster, spill and cove clearance need testing. A 28 ft raster is at the nominal wide limit near 38 ft; 4 ft extra is not promised.
